# WBill - Digital Billing App

> WBill (https://wbill.app) is a digital billing and purchase-record platform. Businesses create bills, share them instantly with customers and keep every purchase organised as a lasting digital record instead of paper bill books. Customers get their purchase history in one place. Free to get started during early access.

WBill is an independent product at wbill.app. It is not WaBill, WeBill365 or BILL.com.

## Key facts
- Name: WBill (also written "wbill", "W Bill")
- Website: https://wbill.app
- Category: digital billing / purchase-record software
- Market: India; works for any kind of business
- Status: early access — sign up at https://wbill.app/signup/ ; mobile apps for Android and iOS are coming
- Price: free to start — https://wbill.app/pricing/
- Contact: support@wbill.app
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wbillapp/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@wbillapp
